_about: Cleanup cases. Each case passes when every check holds. includes / includes_any / excludes are case-insensitive; includes_exact is case-sensitive; excludes match whole words. max_words catches added content. Every case also runs the global checks in scripts/eval_cleanup.py (no preamble, no quotes, no tags). 'rule' is the rule number in CleanupPrompt.swift.
